limitations: Official selectors are unconfirmed; settings screenshots were not supplied.
Corner and crop reviews are assistant visual annotations, not independent human verification or subpixel metrology.
All baseline images retain last-move highlights; there are no truly unmarked examples.
No quantitative illumination, camera-pose or sharpness measurements.
Matched visible artwork does not prove coverage of all twelve piece designs when some classes are absent.
Lichess sessions are distinct games per user confirmation, but their identifiers and relation to older sources remain unconfirmed.
position7 has overlapping vertical arrow shafts with unresolved origin pairing. The screenshot is the authoritative mark reference; partial mark annotations are not a synthesis recipe.
